provenance.creation: New synthetic RU/EN disclosure controls, created from the frozen policy and sharing scenario before the first model call on these documents.
provenance.author_relation: Same assistant system as benchmark preparation; policy known, not an external independent evaluation.
provenance.construction_access: No deliberate reading of prior calibration fixture/gold or raw model responses while constructing this dataset. Prior project context was inherited.
provenance.model_output_access: No outputs on this fresh dataset existed or were inspected during construction.
provenance.real_data: All names, organizations, accounts, numbers, credentials and resources are invented; no live credentials or user documents.
provenance.use: Transfer check after calibration; score all three expected verdict classes separately.
provenance.change_rule: Content edits after first model invocation require a new dataset version/id and new result profile.

offset_convention: Python Unicode code point indices, UTF-8 LF source; end exclusive
id_algorithm: first 24 hex characters of SHA-256(UTF8(file + NUL + value + NUL + str(start) + NUL + str(end))); independent of expected verdict
